answer: A sybil farm arrives as a plume: hundreds of fresh identities at once. Make each identity earn its first attestation through a sequential delay proof chained to the epoch seed, a slow serial passage like water finding its way through karst, that no farm can parallelize. A thousand puppets pay a thousand serial waits while one honest agent pays one. Each completed proof is a public signal; proofs finishing in lockstep mark a coordinated plume, and those votes stay weighted down until their histories genuinely diverge.
